notes.title: Changes in ver2.0
notes.content:
1.Add 2 new maps.
2.Change the rule of using skills.
3.Now every hero have 2 normal skills and 1 super skill.Normal skills with no cost but have colddown time.The super skill will consume all of your energy.
4.Now gun weapons not need change ammo clip any more.
5.Now heros can not attack the tower or base directly.
6.In every 2 mins both side would spawn a warrior which can only attack the tower.
7.Once you destroy a defence tower,and will upgrade your troops level.
8.Map the distribution of neutral colored monsters, creeps kill the hero can get money and experience a different level creeps, heroes and experience gained are not the same money.
9.Add buff area in new map.
10.You can improve your troops level in the mystical store.
11.There is a mystical area near the base,which you can change the hero.
12.Now left handle can only cast skill,and right handle can only control moving.
